# Vendored HAProxy Releases

This directory contains unmodified HAProxy Community source release archives and their published checksum files.

| Version | Source archive | Published checksum |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 3.2.11 | [haproxy-3.2.11.tar.gz](https://www.haproxy.org/download/3.2/src/haproxy-3.2.11.tar.gz) | [SHA-256](https://www.haproxy.org/download/3.2/src/haproxy-3.2.11.tar.gz.sha256) |
| 3.2.12 | [haproxy-3.2.12.tar.gz](https://www.haproxy.org/download/3.2/src/haproxy-3.2.12.tar.gz) | [SHA-256](https://www.haproxy.org/download/3.2/src/haproxy-3.2.12.tar.gz.sha256) |

HAProxy is primarily licensed under GPL version 2. Some headers use LGPL terms, and the release includes an OpenSSL exception.
Each archive contains the upstream `LICENSE`, `doc/gpl.txt`, and `doc/lgpl.txt` files.
The repository's MIT license does not relicense these third-party archives.
